notes: Runs execute sequentially. No other agent-driven compilation or test runs overlap timing.
mattn and modernc columns pool controls across three executables (15 samples each); each native time ratio uses its own run's matching mattn median.
CGO static means the SQLite engine is linked into the executable, not a fully static libc/musl executable.
PureGo is forced with sqlite_purego because mattn requires CGO in the benchmark executable.
modernc reports the same SQLite 3.54.1 source ID, with different compile options; it is not the same native binary.
Affinity pins four distinct physical cores; no frequency lock, exclusive background-load isolation or confidence intervals. Go heap metrics exclude some engine allocations.
Fresh full runs after metadata/cleanup/scratch optimizations supersede earlier 17-workload runs. Matching controls are retained for every native backend.
Earlier scripts overrode default CGO CFLAGS when adding -I; these selected runs explicitly preserve -O2 -g for CGO bridges and mattn. Native SQLite itself remains the same O2-built library.

exploratory_run.reason: Earlier optimization iteration showed correlated control slowdowns. It is retained for history and excluded from the fresh final runs.
